name: Stremio
author: Korie
description: Films and series from Stremio add-ons. Add the Stremio add-ons you use on its page and everyone gets them, no Stremio account needed. Someone who signs in to Stremio also gets their own Stremio add-ons, and what they watch in Korie shows up in Stremio's Continue Watching too, and the other way round. Streams play when an add-on gives a web address; add-ons that only give torrents can't be played.

accounts.label: Stremio account
accounts.help: Signing in is optional. Korie keeps only Stremio's sign-in key, never the password.
